A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ComputerRL and retain the same central framework and training approach. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support reliable comparison despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original OSWorld evaluations, framework and training ablations, training curves, error analysis, and execution demonstrations.

after.justification: v2 retains original empirical results and adds OfficeWorld evaluations and results for GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking.

M1.justification: v2 adds a multimodal GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking variant whose observations use screenshots instead of the accessibility tree (Appendix C). The API-GUI framework, step-level GRPO objective, reward assignment, and Entropulse procedure remain substantively unchanged.

E1.justification: Beyond the retained OSWorld and OSWorld-Verified evaluations, v2 introduces OfficeWorld: 180 office tasks drawn from SpreadsheetBench, PPTC, and internally developed Writer tasks. This substantially expands the evaluated data within spreadsheet, presentation, and document manipulation.

E2.justification: v2 adds an eight-baseline OfficeWorld comparison, including DeepSeek-V3.1, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-4.1, and standalone OpenAI o3 under a common tool framework. This substantially expands the evaluated comparator set. The original OSWorld Table 1 baseline membership is unchanged.

E3.justification: The new OfficeWorld comparison specifies shared tools, framework, and testing conditions. The added multimodal configuration uses screenshots resized from 1920×1080 to 1280×720. Existing ablation settings are retained; Appendix D's newly documented training settings do not establish changes to earlier experiments.

E4.justification: The framework and training ablations match across v1 Table 2 and v2 Table 3. Figure 5's Entropulse comparison, the error analysis, and all six demonstrations are retained. Redrawing the error distribution and relocating demonstrations introduce no new analysis.

E5.justification: v2 Table 6 newly discloses training seed 42. Both versions already report ± values in Table 1 and 95% confidence intervals in training plots. Neither specifies repeated-run counts, and no increase in statistical replication is established.

E6.justification: v2 adds GLM-4.1V results of 48.9±0.5 on OSWorld and 48.0 on OSWorld-Verified; retained GLM-4 results remain 48.1±1.0 and 47.3. New OfficeWorld averages are 41.1 and 43.3 for the two proposed variants, versus 33.9 for OpenAI o3. Qwen's Table 1 row disappears, but its 45.8 result remains in the ablation. The headline increase reflects a different backbone.

T1.justification: The step-level GRPO objective and normalized reward advantage remain mathematically equivalent. Changing conditioning notation from q to q_i,j clarifies the step context without changing the derivation. Neither version adds formal guarantees or proofs.

C1.justification: The central API-GUI, scalable infrastructure, and Entropulse contribution claims remain. v2 adds an explicit resource contribution in the abstract by introducing OfficeWorld and announcing code and benchmark availability.

C2.justification: Appendix C newly explains how active-application API filtering reduces selection complexity and how omitting historical GUI observations preserves useful interaction history within context limits. Existing interpretations of Entropulse and limitations concerning robustness, long-horizon autonomy, and safety are largely retained.

D1.justification: New Appendices B–E document action definitions, 103 application APIs, prompt and observation formats, history handling, training hyperparameters, computing resources, and annotation procedures. The abstract also adds a code/OfficeWorld repository link. Appendix A largely relocates the previously described API construction workflow.

R1.justification: v2 adds a dedicated related-work section covering language and vision-language models, computer agents, benchmarks, and RL frameworks. New discussion includes CogAgent, OS-Atlas, ZeroGUI, WebArena, SWE-bench, PPO, and Verl, substantially expanding research positioning beyond v1's introductory citations.

P1.justification: Sections 2–3 are extensively condensed and rewritten. Detailed API construction moves to Appendix A, Future Direction moves from Section 5 to Appendix F, demonstrations move from Appendix A to G, and a new related-work section and technical appendices substantially reorganize the narrative.

P2.justification: v2 adds OfficeWorld, action-space, API-count, and training-configuration tables, plus two annotation-guideline figures. The error table becomes a pie chart with unchanged proportions, and retained displays are repositioned. The demonstration images remain identical despite renumbering.

improvement.justification: v2 substantially addresses v1's missing reproducibility information through explicit observation and prompt formats, action definitions, training configurations, and annotation instructions in Appendices B–E. OfficeWorld also supplies additional empirical comparisons under shared tools and settings. Repeated-run reporting remains underspecified, and the higher headline score uses a different backbone, but the substantial gains in technical transparency and empirical support clearly improve overall quality.
